name: Roast Beef Sandwich Bento Box with Cheese Puffs, Celery Bites & Canned Peaches

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Wash, dry, trim, and cut celery into bite-sized pieces. Place in one of the small compartments of the bento box.
Drain peaches and place in the second small compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup sliced peaches in juice

instructions.primary_message: Place cheese puffs in the medium compartment of the bento box.

Spread mayo over bread slices. Layer cheese and roast beef on one slice of bread, then close sandwich with the remaining slice of bread. Cut in half and place in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp mayonnaise
2 slice white bread
2 slice American cheese
4 oz deli roast beef, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
